summary: Clearing a layer answers with the arrangement that resolves after it is gone, so the panel redraws without reading the record again.

then.note: A reset is a write against the revision, not a deletion, and the component never sends its own idea of the defaults -- the host owns those, and writing them would overwrite them with a guess. The answer carries what now resolves because a second read would show the person a reload for a change they already made.
